SELECT MOIM_ID ,MOIM_TITLE ,MOIM_TITLE_EN ,MOIM_TITLE_JA FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST WHERE MOIM_ID IN
#{moimId}

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,d.USER_NM ,COALESCE(v.VISIT_CNT, 0) AS VISIT_CNT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,COALESCE(m.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT ,c.CATE_CD ,c.CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO d ON a.CREATE_USER = d.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID ,COUNT(USER_ID) AS MEMBER_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) m ON a.MOIM_ID = m.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID ,COUNT(VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_VISIT_H GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) v ON a.MOIM_ID = v.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.MOIM_ID ,GROUP_CONCAT(e.CATE_CD ORDER BY e.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD ,GROUP_CONCAT(f.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY f.CMM_CM_NM) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE e LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D f ON e.CATE_CD = f.CMM_CDV AND f.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND f.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY e.MOIM_ID ) c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId}

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER
,MAX((SELECT t1.FIRST_IMAGE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CALENDAR cal LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST t1 ON cal.TOUR_ID = t1.TOUR_ID WHERE cal.MOIM_ID = a.MOIM_ID ORDER BY cal.START_DT ASC, cal.RMKS ASC LIMIT 1)) AS IMAGE_URL ,COUNT(c.USER_ID) AS memberCnt ,a.CREATE_USER AS USER_ID ,b.USER_NM ,b.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS HOST_PROFILE_IMG_URL
,(SELECT AVG(r1.REVIEW_SCORE) FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW r1 LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST r2 ON r1.MOIM_ID = r2.MOIM_ID WHERE r1.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O' AND (r2.CREATE_USER = a.CREATE_USER OR r1.CREATE_USER = a.CREATE_USER) ) AS REVIEW_SCORE FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.CREATE_USER = b.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID AND c.ROLE_CD = 'A' WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} GROUP BY a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,a.CREATE_USER ,b.USER_NM ,b.PROFILE_IMG_URL

SELECT b.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,b.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b ON a.CATE_CD = b.CMM_CDV AND b.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND b.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId}

SELECT a.START_DT ,a.RMKS ,a.TOUR_ID
,COALESCE(NULLIF(en.TOUR_NM, ''), NULLIF(b.TOUR_NM_EN, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM ,COALESCE(NULLIF(jp.TOUR_NM, ''), NULLIF(b.TOUR_NM_JA, ''), b.TOUR_NM) AS TOUR_NM ,b.TOUR_NM
,b.ROAD_ADDR ,d.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,d.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM
,(CASE WHEN en.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(b.TOUR_NM_EN, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN ,(CASE WHEN jp.TOUR_ID IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(b.TOUR_NM_JA, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN ,'N' AS NATIVE_MATCH_YN
FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CALENDAR a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST b ON a.TOUR_ID = b.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_CATE c ON b.TOUR_ID = c.TOUR_ID AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D d ON c.CATE_CD = d.CMM_CDV AND d.CMM_CD_ID = 'TOUR_LCLS_CD' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_EN_LIST en ON a.TOUR_ID = en.TOUR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_JP_LIST jp ON a.TOUR_ID = jp.TOUR_ID WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.RMKS
SELECT a.ROLE_CD ,a.STATE_CD FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER a WHERE 1=1 AND a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} AND a.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O' THEN 'Y' END), 'N') AS MOIM_REVIEWED_YN ,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'T' THEN 'Y' END), 'N') AS TOUR_REVIEWED_YN FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW WHERE MOIM_ID = #{moimId} AND CREATE_USER = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_MOIM_VISIT_H (MOIM_ID, USER_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DT) SELECT #{moimId}, #{userId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_VISIT_H WHERE MOIM_ID = #{moimId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} )

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,a.MOIM_DSCR ,a.MOIM_START_DT ,a.MOIM_END_DT ,a.MAX_MEMBER ,COALESCE(m.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT ,my_m.ROLE_CD ,my_m.STATE_CD ,c.CATE_CD ,c.CATE_NM ,CASE WHEN r.REVIEW_CNT > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REVIEWED_YN FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID, COUNT(USER_ID) AS MEMBER_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) m ON a.MOIM_ID = m.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.MOIM_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(e.CATE_CD ORDER BY e.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD, GROUP_CONCAT(f.CMM_CM_NM ORDER BY f.CMM_CM_NM) AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_CATE e LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D f ON e.CATE_CD = f.CMM_CDV AND f.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND f.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY e.MOIM_ID ) c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MOIM_ID, COUNT(1) AS REVIEW_CNT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW WHERE CREATE_USER = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY MOIM_ID ) r ON a.MOIM_ID = r.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER my_m ON my_m.MOIM_ID = a.MOIM_ID WHERE a.USE_YN = 'Y' AND my_m.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT a.MOIM_ID ,a.MOIM_TITLE ,c.RMKS AS TIME ,c.TOUR_ID AS TOUR_ID ,t.TOUR_NM AS PLACE_NAME FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER b ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID AND b.USER_ID = #{userId} AND b.STATE_CD = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_CALENDAR c ON a.MOIM_ID = c.MOIM_ID AND c.START_DT = #{today} LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_TOUR_LIST t ON c.TOUR_ID = t.TOUR_ID WHERE a.USE_YN = 'Y' AND a.MOIM_START_DT <= #{today} AND a.MOIM_END_DT >= #{today} ORDER BY a.MOIM_ID, c.RMKS
SELECT a.CMM_CDV AS CATE_CD ,a.CMM_CM_NM AS CATE_NM FROM TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D a WHERE a.CMM_CD_ID = 'CATE_ID' AND a.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT a.USER_ID ,b.USER_NM ,b.PROFILE_IMG_URL ,a.ROLE_CD ,a.STATE_CD FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_MEMBER a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.USER_ID = b.USER_ID WHERE a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.ROLE_CD, a.CREATE_DT

SELECT a.REVIEW_ID ,b.USER_NM ,a.REVIEW_SCORE ,a.REVIEW_CONTENT ,a.REVIEW_CONTENT_EN ,a.REVIEW_CONTENT_JA ,a.IMG_URLS ,a.CREATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.CREATE_USER = b.USER_ID WHERE a.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O' AND a.MOIM_ID = #{moimId} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT DESC
